summary: A bounded two-dimensional random-slope density / robust two-anchor cross determinant alone cannot be upgraded from the fresh finite-Lp theorem to Linfinity. For independent cap-one U1,U2,V1,V2 and block matrix [[K,I],[I,K^{-1}]] with K=epsilon[[0,1],[1,0]], det(CC^T)=1 but Q=2epsilon Z1Z2 for independent Z1,Z2 whose densities are positive near zero, so p_Q has a logarithmic singularity. The Schur complement is exactly zero and the full matrix has rank two, so this refutes only the over-generalized receiver, not the s8 or full QFORM target. The eight-eigenvalue proof must spend additional Schur/overlap-one curvature.
